title: Produce the Italian Fibonacci Sol candidate
description: Implement only the Italian Fibonacci product under a Sol worker. Use a transaction-specific output area, preserve exact inputs and accounting returned by STARCHART, and do not inspect or modify the Luna candidate. Do not rebuild or modify STARCHART.
design:
Purpose: Implement the frozen Italian Fibonacci specification using the current Sol worker in an isolated transaction.
Preconditions: The SPEC digest is exact; the Luna candidate is unavailable to this worker; the accepted STARCHART release is unchanged.
Principal postcondition: A self-contained Sol candidate and reproducible verification outputs satisfy the frozen Italian Fibonacci SPEC without reading the Luna candidate.
Work kind: implementation
Build mode: none
Recipe:
acceptance_criteria: The program, tests, verifier output, artifact inventory, and limitations are returned durably; all deterministic SPEC checks pass or one concrete blocker is reported; transaction accounting is preserved without invented cost figures.

dependencies.title: Italian Fibonacci controlled model comparison
dependencies.description: Run Italian Fibonacci as a controlled product exercise through the accepted STARCHART rail, comparing isolated Luna and Sol candidates from one frozen SPEC and delivering a self-contained public product-plus-receipts bundle.
dependencies.design: Two isolated implementation transactions receive identical inputs; a separate verification unit compares correctness, process, accounting, and provenance without changing the accepted STARCHART runtime.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Independent Quality accepts a canonical product; raw Beads and transaction records, available accounting, process notes, reproducible verification, final artifacts, manifest links, and SHA-256 digests form a distribution-quality evidence directory.
